arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskName = 'Codex_Open_Speedometer31_20260904T1522'
$edge = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'
$url = 'https://browserbench.org/Speedometer3.1/?startAutomatically=true&iterationCount=1'
$user = 'DESKTOP-5OJC3K4\Song'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $edge -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('Edge not found: ' + $edge) }
$activeUser = (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem).UserName
if ($activeUser -ne $user) { throw ('Interactive user mismatch: ' + $activeUser) }
$edgeVersion = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $edge).VersionInfo.ProductVersion
$arguments = '--new-window ' + [char]34 + $url + [char]34
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $edge -Argument $arguments
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $user -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 5) -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries
try {
 Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
 Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName
 Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
 $info = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $taskName
 [pscustomobject]@{OpenedUrl=$url;EdgeVersion=$edgeVersion;InteractiveUser=$user;LastRunTime=$info.LastRunTime;LastTaskResult=$info.LastTaskResult;TaskState=(Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName).State} | Format-List
} finally {
 Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
